metadata.case_name: SO MAN v. SO TING T/A FUNG KEE WASTE WOODEN & METAL COLLECTION CO

plaintiff.expected_occupation_after: lighter work (messenger, car park attendant or security guard)

injuries.description: The Plaintiff suffered a sprain injury to his back. The MRI scan showed a disc prolapse with bilateral nerve root compression at L4/5. Both Dr Lau and Dr Wong ... agreed that unsurprisingly for a 47-year old, the Plaintiff suffers from a pre-existing degeneration of the spine.
source: The Plaintiff suffered a sprain injury to his back. The MRI scan showed a disc prolapse with bilateral nerve root compression at L4/5. In 2000 and 2002, he had also sprained his back but on each occasion it recovered following a period of rest. Both Dr Lau and Dr Wong, the orthopaedic specialists retained by the parties, agreed that unsurprisingly for a 47-year old, the Plaintiff suffers from a pre-existing degeneration of the spine.
injuries.icd_description: Injury of nerve root of lumbar spine

manifestations.description: pain described as mild to moderate (4 to 5 on a scale of 10)
unable to return to pre-accident employment / cannot be recommended to return to pre-accident employment

losses.description: Intermittent pain and reduced function of his back following the sprain and disc prolapse with nerve root compression at L4/5.
Unable to return to his pre-accident employment as a foreman and forced to consider lighter work such as messenger, car park attendant or security guard.
